notes.title: 20240403 Update
notes.content:
20240329
Want to make an official modifier for the stand-alone version of Old Flash
I found that Flash 2 was actually developed by as1, so I spent 15 hours transforming it into as2. The next day I found that some flash software bugs failed to be saved inexplicably, so I spent another day revising it.
Modifying the unity collection interface, unity is forced to read the article inexplicably, and the article is read even after restarting. Fortunately, there is a backup, and the backup package is imported into the new project. Hold
The flash software failed to save to disk many times. It was initially determined that global search and replacement had a high probability of failing to save to disk.

20240331
English version of Flash 2. Abandon the multi-language version. The transformation cost is too high. Use the original English version for transformation.
Flash 3 turns out to be AS1, fuck, and there is a high chance that the global search and replace will fail to save, so use a higher version of the software to remake it. Just one setProperty alone has more than 300 items that need to be modified. There are currently no save failures found.
It seems that higher versions of flash can solve the problem of global search and replacement failure.

Flashing 4, 5, and 6 modifiers takes less time and takes more than 1 day.

Unity's CPU usage was inexplicably too high, even if the scene was empty. Damn it, and then it was inexplicably low. I suspect it is due to the player, something like Windows forcing itself to update itself.

Oh, and the size limit has been removed. It was set up so that the picture would not be deformed or stuck. Now that the screen size is getting bigger, the picture will be lousy or the lag will be laggy. It’s up to you to enlarge the original intention.

20240403
I cried to death when the accident happened again. I thought I was just testing it, but the players said they had seen the modifier. It was the modifier DLC that I used to extend my life. There is no other way but to let players who have already seen it continue to use it, otherwise there will definitely be another flood of bad reviews. DLC is still under review. I should be able to upload it in a while.

notes.title: 2021 / 2 / 28 optimization update
notes.content:
Sleep function is added to the main window. When running the game, the main window will sleep, saving a lot of CPU power.

Note that you must close the open game window before the main window can resume operation.

During the operation of the game window, it is normal that the main window does not respond. There is no need to worry. At this time, the CPU consumption of the main window is 0.

This update test is OK, but if there are any serious bugs, please contact the author in time!

tags.feature: Sleep function is added to the main window.
